items.source: Initialize the logging system according to preferences expressed through the Environment and the classpath.
items.translation: 根据通过 Environment 和类路径表达的偏好初始化日志系统。

items.source: Set logging levels based on relevant Environment properties.

items.translation: LoggingApplicationListener 的默认顺序。

items.source:
The name of the Spring property that controls the registration of a shutdown hook
to shut down the logging system when the JVM exits.
items.translation: 控制注册关闭钩子以在 JVM 退出时关闭日志系统的 Spring 属性名称。

items.source: Sets a custom logging level to be used for Spring Boot and related libraries.
items.translation: 设置用于 Spring Boot 及相关库的自定义日志级别。

items.source: environment - the environment
items.translation: environment - 环境

items.source: Debug and trace logging for Spring, Tomcat, Jetty and Hibernate will be enabled when the environment contains debug or trace properties that aren't set to "false" (i.e. if you start your application using java -jar myapp.jar [--debug | --trace]). If you prefer to ignore these properties you can set parseArgs to false.
items.translation: Spring、Tomcat、Jetty 和 Hibernate 的调试和跟踪日志将在环境包含未设置为 `"false"` 的 `debug` 或 `trace` 属性时启用（即，如果您使用 `java -jar myapp.jar [--debug | --trace]` 启动应用程序）。如果您希望忽略这些属性，可以将 parseArgs 设置为 `false`。

items.source: By default, log output is only written to the console. If a log file is required, the logging.file.path and logging.file.name properties can be used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，日志输出仅写入控制台。如果需要日志文件，可以使用`logging.file.path`和`logging.file.name`属性。

items.source:
Some system properties may be set as side effects, and these can be useful if the
logging configuration supports placeholders (i.e. log4j or logback):
items.translation: 某些系统属性可能作为副作用被设置，如果日志配置支持占位符（即 log4j 或 logback），这些属性将非常有用：

items.source: Initialize loggers based on the springBootLogging setting.
items.translation: 根据springBootLogging设置初始化日志记录器。

items.source: Initialize loggers based on the springBootLogging setting. By default this implementation will pick an appropriate set of loggers to configure based on the level.
items.translation: 根据springBootLogging设置初始化日志记录器。默认情况下，此实现将根据级别选择适当的日志记录器集进行配置。

items.source: Sets if initialization arguments should be parsed for debug and trace properties (usually defined from --debug or --trace command line args). Defaults to true.
items.translation: 设置是否解析初始化参数以获取调试和跟踪属性（通常由 `--debug` 或 `--trace` 命令行参数定义）。默认为 `true`。
